title: Genesis Block Wallet Puzzle

author.name: anonymous (on-chain only, OP_RETURN messages to the escrow)

prize.note: 38 P2WSH outputs to one witness script; the jackpot grows because the author relays every paid question into the escrow (125,779 sats on 2026-08-24, 142,779 on 2026-08-29, 168,779 on 2026-09-12, 231,501 later on 2026-09-17)

target_format: P2WSH v0; witness script OP_2 <keyA> <keyB> OP_2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG; both keys derived from genesis data through a 12-word BIP39 mnemonic whose entropy is a 128-bit digest, with a name as passphrase, along BIP48 m/48'/0'/account'/script_type' with a genesis value as account

derivation.summary: build a 12-word BIP39 mnemonic from a 128-bit digest of genesis data, add the passphrase (the name of whoever received the first transaction, in an undisclosed format), derive along BIP48 m/48'/0'/account'/script_type' with a genesis value as account, build the 2-of-2 witness script in either key order, sha256 it, and compare with the published 32-byte witness program
derivation.certified_against: the BIP-173 P2WSH test vector, and a real 2-of-2 P2WSH spent in block 963629 (tx 47ded3504e855ce418e46eeca4694b55a623d1e23a8e3c83292abbcf9cee9f7a, input 0) whose revealed keys rebuild the script and hash to the spent address; private key 1 to the generator point; negative control against the escrow

difficulty_note: the lock is fully characterized (2-of-2 P2WSH, exact offline oracle) and the corpus is 285 public bytes; passes 1 and 2 (2026-08-29) exhausted the mechanical readings of the August hints, pass 3 (2026-09-12) killed the raw 16-byte window model, and the author confirmed on 2026-09-15 that the entropy is not the raw 16 bytes but a 128-bit digest and that the passphrase is a name, the name of whoever received the first transaction; pass 4 (2026-09-17, three waves, 8.03e9 ordered pairs over 6,078 digest entropies and up to 137 name formats, witnesses re-found) shows the digest input is none of the 73 canonical genesis readings nor of 300 typed forms of the texts; the author answered the question that asks which input is hashed by naming the four forms the data can be written in (binary, hex, decimal, ASCII) while refusing to name the part, and wave 4 (2026-09-17, 11.74e9 pairs over 25 parts in 11 renderings, witness re-found) matched nothing; wave 5 (2026-09-17, 1.67e9 pairs over 133 parts including the coinbase fields, the script pieces and 114 windows, with the two cosigners taken from one part as the author's "same Genesis field" requires) matched nothing either; the open unknown is which part of the block carries the entropy; wave 6 (2026-09-18, 3.57e9 pairs) adds MD4, MD2, Keccak and SM3 as the digest and uncompressed keys in the witness script, and matches nothing either; a 10,000-sat question asking for the category of the entropy input was refused on 2026-09-18, so the author sells facts about the form of the input and not about the input itself

leads.title: ask the author which 128-bit digest function (48-byte draft in the README); the category question was refused at 10,000 sats on 2026-09-18
buy the digest function on chain (48-byte draft in the README): MD5 or truncated SHA256, which divides the space by 16 whatever the input is
enumerate the parts wave 5 did not reach: windows at stride 1, lengths other than 16 and 32, explorer JSON renderings
watch the escrow for new OP_RETURN hints or a spend before any work
the author's 50,000-sat offer to reveal the escrow public keys; removes pairing but not derivation, about a factor of two, and says nothing about the input
pass 4 wave 4: 25 genesis parts in 11 renderings of the four forms, 4,284 entropies, 11.74e9 pairs
pass 4 wave 6: eight further digest readings and uncompressed key encoding, 3.57e9 pairs
pass 4 wave 5: 133 parts (coinbase fields, script pieces, 114 windows) in the four forms, cosigners from one part, 1.67e9 pairs
pass 4 waves 1 to 3: 128-bit digest entropies with name passphrases, canonical and typed inputs, both cosigner readings, 8.03e9 pairs
pass 3: 16-byte genesis windows as 12-word entropy, 53 passphrases, genesis integers as BIP48 account, script types 0/1/2, keys paired (2.46e12 pairs)
pass 2: library-specific roots (hashed roots, raw 64-byte extended key, raw key with zero chain code) along the same 214 paths
pass 1: literal readings of the 2026-08-28 hints, families A to D
